dct_description_sm: Dataset to download and use for generating the results of the article "Assessing the potential human health impacts of freshwater consumption: considering inequalities in water availability to assess the consequences of domestic water deprivation" The data folder can be used with the following code : https://github.com/LauraDebarre/Water_domestic_Human_health
dct_title_s: Dataset for the article "Assessing the potential human health impacts of freshwater consumption: considering inequalities in water availability to assess the consequences of domestic water deprivation"
